parents.subject: Engineering Technology and Management for Agricultural Systems

ns2:course.label: Special Topics
ns2:course.description: Group discussion or an experimental course on a special topic in technical systems management. 1 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated, if topics vary, in the same term or separate terms to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: As specified for each topic offering; see Class Schedule or departmental course information.
